scripts.title: inf stamina
scripts.script:
local players = game:GetService("Players")

local player = players.LocalPlayer
local connections = {}

local function disconnect_all()
    for _, connection in ipairs(connections) do
        connection:Disconnect()
    end

    table.clear(connections)
end

local function update_stamina()
    local character = player.Character
    if not character then
        return
    end

    character:SetAttribute("StaminaDisabled", true)

    local player_gui = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
    local core_hud = player_gui and player_gui:FindFirstChild("CoreHud")
    local player_info = core_hud and core_hud:FindFirstChild("PlayerInfo")
    local bars = player_info and player_info:FindFirstChild("Bars")
    local stamina = bars and bars:FindFirstChild("Stamina")

    if not stamina then
        return
    end

    local amount = stamina:FindFirstChild("Amount")
    if amount and amount:IsA("TextLabel") then
        amount.Text = "100/100"
    end

    local bar = stamina:FindFirstChild("Bar")
    local clipping = bar and bar:FindFirstChild("Clipping")

    if clipping then
        clipping.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)

        local top = clipping:FindFirstChild("Top")
        if top then
            top.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
        end
    end
end

local function bind_character(character)
    disconnect_all()

    character:SetAttribute("StaminaDisabled", true)

    table.insert(connections, character.AttributeChanged:Connect(function(attribute)
        if attribute == "StaminaDisabled"
            and character:GetAttribute("StaminaDisabled") ~= true then
            character:SetAttribute("StaminaDisabled", true)
        end
    end))

    task.spawn(function()
        while character.Parent and player.Character == character do
            update_stamina()
            task.wait(0.1)
        end
    end)
end

if player.Character then
    bind_character(player.Character)
end

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(bind_character)

local IDLE = "rbxassetid://77069998410842"
local WALK = "rbxassetid://71037783668661"
local RUN = "rbxassetid://71603364430813"
local KILL = "rbxassetid://125724130705142"
local SLASH = "rbxassetid://85075426218982"
local FOOTSTEP_ID = "rbxassetid://137620518840395"
local enabled = false
local curTrack, conn, stepConn, animConn
local tracks = {}
local stepSound = nil
local isKilling = false
local function fullStop()
	if curTrack then pcall(function() curTrack:Stop(0.15) end) curTrack=nil end
	if conn then conn:Disconnect() conn=nil end
	if stepConn then stepConn:Disconnect() stepConn=nil end
	if animConn then animConn:Disconnect() animConn=nil end
	for _, t in pairs(tracks) do pcall(function() t:Stop(0.15) end) end
	tracks = {}
	if stepSound then stepSound:Destroy() stepSound=nil end
end
local function createFootstepSound(root)
	if stepSound then stepSound:Destroy() end
	stepSound = Instance.new("Sound")
	stepSound.Name = "FootstepSound"
	stepSound.SoundId = FOOTSTEP_ID
	stepSound.Volume = 1.2
	stepSound.Parent = root
end
local function play(name)
	if not enabled or isKilling then return end
	if not tracks[name] then return end
	if curTrack == tracks[name] then return end
	if curTrack then curTrack:Stop(0.15) end
	curTrack = tracks[name]
	curTrack:Play(0.15)
end
local function loadAll(hum)
	fullStop()
	local char = hum.Parent
	local root = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local animator = hum:WaitForChild("Animator")
	createFootstepSound(root)
	local function make(id, name)
		local a = Instance.new("Animation") a.Name = name a.AnimationId = id
		return animator:LoadAnimation(a)
	end
	tracks.Idle = make(IDLE, "Idle")
	tracks.Walk = make(WALK, "Walk")
	tracks.Run = make(RUN, "Run")
	tracks.Kill = make(KILL, "Kill")
	tracks.Slash = make(SLASH, "Slash")
	tracks.Kill.Looped = false tracks.Kill.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action4
	tracks.Slash.Looped = false tracks.Slash.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action3
	for _, n in pairs({"Idle","Walk","Run"}) do
		tracks[n].Looped = true tracks[n].Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Movement
	end
	animConn = animator.AnimationPlayed:Connect(function(track)
		if not enabled then return end
		local name = track.Name:lower()
		if name:find("slash") or name:find("attack") then
			track:Stop(0)
			tracks.Slash:Play(0.05)
			tracks.Slash.Stopped:Wait()
			if hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0 then
				if hum.WalkSpeed > 16 then play("Run") else play("Walk") end
			else
				play("Idle")
			end
		end
	end)
end
local function doKillAnim(hum)
	if isKilling or not enabled then return end
	isKilling = true
	local oldWalk = hum.WalkSpeed
	local oldJump = hum.JumpPower
	if curTrack then curTrack:Stop(0.1) end
	if stepSound then stepSound:Stop() end
	hum.WalkSpeed = 0 hum.JumpPower = 0 hum.AutoRotate = false
	tracks.Kill:Play()
	tracks.Kill.Stopped:Wait()
	if tracks.Idle then
		if curTrack then curTrack:Stop(0.1) end
		curTrack = tracks.Idle
		curTrack:Play(0.1)
	end
	task.wait(1)
	hum.WalkSpeed = oldWalk > 0 and oldWalk or 16
	hum.JumpPower = oldJump > 0 and oldJump or 50
	hum.AutoRotate = true
	isKilling = false
end
local function hookHumanoid(hum)
	loadAll(hum)
	local lastStep = 0
	conn = hum.Running:Connect(function(s)
		if not enabled or isKilling then return end
		if s < 0.1 then play("Idle")
		elseif s < 16 then play("Walk")
		else play("Run") end
	end)
	stepConn = game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		if not enabled or isKilling or not stepSound then return end
		if hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.1 and hum.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air then
			local interval = hum.WalkSpeed > 16 and 0.25 or 0.4
			if tick() - lastStep >= interval then lastStep = tick() stepSound:Play() end
		end
	end)
	play("Idle")
end
local function watchPlayer(other)
	if other == p then return end
	local function onChar(char)
		local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
		hum.Died:Connect(function()
			local tag = hum:FindFirstChild("creator")
			if tag and tag.Value == p and enabled then
				local myChar = p.Character
				if myChar then
					local myHum = myChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
					if myHum then doKillAnim(myHum) end
				end
			end
		end)
	end
	if other.Character then task.spawn(onChar, other.Character) end
	other.CharacterAdded:Connect(onChar)
end
for _, plr in pairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do watchPlayer(plr) end
game.Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(watchPlayer)
b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	enabled = not enabled
	if enabled then
		b.Text = "ANIM: ON"
		b.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0,170,0)
		hookHumanoid((p.Character or p.CharacterAdded:Wait()):WaitForChild("Humanoid"))
	else
		b.Text = "ANIM: OFF"
		b.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80,80,80)
		fullStop()
	end
end)
p.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
	task.wait(0.5)
	if enabled then hookHumanoid(char:WaitForChild("Humanoid")) end
end)

local function pack(value)
    local kind = typeof(value)
    if kind == "Color3" then
        return {__type = "Color3", Values = {value.R, value.G, value.B}}
    elseif kind == "Vector3" then
        return {__type = "Vector3", Values = {value.X, value.Y, value.Z}}
    elseif kind == "EnumItem" then
        return {__type = "EnumItem", Enum = tostring(value.EnumType):gsub("^Enum%.", ""), Name = value.Name}
    elseif kind == "table" then
        local result = {}
        for k, item in pairs(value) do result[k] = pack(item) end
        return result
    elseif kind == "string" or kind == "number" or kind == "boolean" then
        return value
    end
    error("Unsupported snapshot value: " .. kind)
end

local function unpackValue(value)
    if type(value) ~= "table" then return value end
    if value.__type == "Color3" then return Color3.new(value.Values[1], value.Values[2], value.Values[3]) end
    if value.__type == "Vector3" then return Vector3.new(value.Values[1], value.Values[2], value.Values[3]) end
    if value.__type == "EnumItem" then return Enum[value.Enum][value.Name] end
    local result = {}
    for k, item in pairs(value) do result[k] = unpackValue(item) end
    return result
end

local function capture(description, username, userId, rigType)
    local snapshot = {
        Version = 1, Username = username, UserId = userId, RigType = rigType.Name,
        CapturedAt = os.date("!%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"), Properties = {}, Children = {},
        Accessories = pack(description:GetAccessories(true)),
        Emotes = pack(description:GetEmotes()),
        EquippedEmotes = pack(description:GetEquippedEmotes())
    }
    for _, property in ipairs(properties) do
        local ok, value = pcall(function() return description[property] end)
        if ok then snapshot.Properties[property] = pack(value) end
    end
    for _, child in ipairs(description:GetChildren()) do
        local list = childProperties[child.ClassName]
        if list then
            local record = {ClassName = child.ClassName, Properties = {}}
            for _, property in ipairs(list) do
                local ok, value = pcall(function() return child[property] end)
                if ok then record.Properties[property] = pack(value) end
            end
            table.insert(snapshot.Children, record)
        end
    end
    return snapshot
end

local function restoreDescription(snapshot)
    assert(snapshot.Version == 1, "Unsupported snapshot version.")
    local description = Instance.new("HumanoidDescription")
    for property, value in pairs(snapshot.Properties) do
        local ok, err = pcall(function() description[property] = unpackValue(value) end)
        if not ok then warn("Snapshot property " .. property .. ": " .. tostring(err)) end
    end
    description:SetAccessories(unpackValue(snapshot.Accessories or {}), true)
    description:SetEmotes(unpackValue(snapshot.Emotes or {}))
    description:SetEquippedEmotes(unpackValue(snapshot.EquippedEmotes or {}))
    local used = {}
    for _, record in ipairs(snapshot.Children or {}) do
        local p = record.Properties
        local selected
        for _, child in ipairs(description:GetChildren()) do
            if not used[child] and child.ClassName == record.ClassName then
                if record.ClassName == "AccessoryDescription" then
                    if child.AssetId == p.AssetId
                        and child.AccessoryType == unpackValue(p.AccessoryType) then selected = child end
                elseif record.ClassName == "BodyPartDescription" then
                    if child.BodyPart == unpackValue(p.BodyPart) then selected = child end
                end
                if selected then break end
            end
        end
        if not selected then selected = Instance.new(record.ClassName) end
        used[selected] = true
        for property, value in pairs(p) do
            local ok, err = pcall(function() selected[property] = unpackValue(value) end)
            if not ok then warn("Snapshot child " .. property .. ": " .. tostring(err)) end
        end
        selected.Parent = description
    end
    return description
end

local function owningPart(attachment)
    local parent = attachment and attachment.Parent
    while parent and not parent:IsA("BasePart") do parent = parent.Parent end

local function attachmentOffset(part, attachment)
    if attachment.Parent == part then return attachment.CFrame end
    return part.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(attachment.WorldCFrame)

local function bottomY(frame, size)
    return frame.Position.Y - (math.abs(frame.RightVector.Y) * size.X
        + math.abs(frame.UpVector.Y) * size.Y + math.abs(frame.LookVector.Y) * size.Z) * 0.5
end

local function loadAvatar(target)
    if type(target) == "string" then
        target = target:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$"):gsub("^@", "")
        if target == "" then setStatus("Enter a Roblox username.", true) return end
    end
    state.version = state.version + 1
    local version = state.version
    state.selectedSnapshot = nil
    state:ClearAvatar()
    setStatus(type(target) == "table" and "Loading saved avatar..." or "Loading @" .. target .. "...")
    local model, description
    local function cancelled() return state.stopped or version ~= state.version end
    local ok, err = pcall(function()
        local snapshot, rigType
        if type(target) == "table" then
            snapshot = target
            description = restoreDescription(snapshot)
            rigType = Enum.HumanoidRigType[snapshot.RigType]
        else
            local userId = Players:GetUserIdFromNameAsync(target)
            description = Players:GetHumanoidDescriptionFromUserIdAsync(userId)
            rigType = Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15
            local infoOk, info = pcall(function() return Players:GetCharacterAppearanceInfoAsync(userId) end)
            if infoOk and info.playerAvatarType == "R6" then rigType = Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6 end
            snapshot = capture(description, target, userId, rigType)
        end
        if cancelled() then return end
        local character = player.Character
        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        assert(humanoid and root, "Your character is not ready.")
        model = Players:CreateHumanoidModelFromDescriptionAsync(description, rigType)
        if cancelled() or player.Character ~= character then model:Destroy() model = nil return end
        local visualHumanoid = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local visualRoot = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        assert(visualHumanoid and visualRoot, "Avatar model is incomplete.")
        model.Name = "LocalAvatar_" .. snapshot.Username
        visualHumanoid.EvaluateStateMachine = false
        visualHumanoid.AutoRotate = false
        visualHumanoid.RequiresNeck = false
        visualHumanoid.BreakJointsOnDeath = false
        visualHumanoid.DisplayDistanceType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None
        local parts, bodyParts, feet, graph, headParts, accessories, animationIds = {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}
        local animate = model:FindFirstChild("Animate")
        for name, fallback in pairs(defaults[rigType.Name]) do
            local property = animationProperties[name]
            local id = property and description[property] or 0
            animationIds[name] = "rbxassetid://" .. tostring(id > 0 and id or fallback)
            local folder = animate and animate:FindFirstChild(name)
            local animation = folder and folder:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Animation", true)
            if animation and animation.AnimationId ~= "" then animationIds[name] = animation.AnimationId end
            if snapshot.AnimationIds and snapshot.AnimationIds[name] then animationIds[name] = snapshot.AnimationIds[name] end
        end
        for _, object in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
            if object:IsA("BaseScript") then object:Destroy()
            elseif object:IsA("BasePart") then
                object.Anchored, object.CanCollide, object.CanTouch, object.CanQuery = true, false, false, false
                object.Massless = true
                table.insert(parts, object)
                if object.Parent == model then
                    table.insert(bodyParts, object)
                    graph[object] = {}
                    if object.Name == "LeftFoot" or object.Name == "RightFoot"
                        or object.Name == "Left Leg" or object.Name == "Right Leg" then table.insert(feet, object)
                    elseif object.Name == "Head" then headParts[object] = true end
                end
            end
        end
        visualRoot.Transparency = 1
        local function addJoint(a, b, c0, c1, joint)
            if not graph[a] or not graph[b] then return end
            local edge = {a = a, b = b, c0 = c0, c1 = c1, joint = joint}
            table.insert(graph[a], edge) table.insert(graph[b], edge)
        end
        for _, joint in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
            if joint:IsA("Motor6D") then addJoint(joint.Part0, joint.Part1, joint.C0, joint.C1, joint)
            elseif joint:IsA("AnimationConstraint") then
                local a, b = owningPart(joint.Attachment0), owningPart(joint.Attachment1)
                if graph[a] and graph[b] then
                    joint.IsKinematic = true
                    addJoint(a, b, attachmentOffset(a, joint.Attachment0), attachmentOffset(b, joint.Attachment1), joint)
                end
            end
        end
        local function solve(frame, animated)
            local poses, queue, index = {[visualRoot] = frame}, {visualRoot}, 1
            while index <= #queue do
                local part = queue[index]
                index = index + 1
                for _, edge in ipairs(graph[part]) do
                    local forward = part == edge.a
                    local other = forward and edge.b or edge.a
                    if not poses[other] then
                        local transform = animated and edge.joint.Transform or CFrame.identity
                        local relative = edge.c0 * transform * edge.c1:Inverse()
                        poses[other] = poses[part] * (forward and relative or relative:Inverse())
                        table.insert(queue, other)
                    end
                end
            end
            return poses
        end
        local neutral = solve(CFrame.identity, false)
        if rigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15 then
            local groups = {}
            for _, part in ipairs(bodyParts) do
                for _, attachment in ipairs(part:GetChildren()) do
                    if attachment:IsA("Attachment") and attachment.Name:match("RigAttachment$") then
                        groups[attachment.Name] = groups[attachment.Name] or {}
                        table.insert(groups[attachment.Name], attachment)
                    end
                end
            end
            for _ = 1, #bodyParts do
                local repaired = false
                for name, group in pairs(groups) do
                    for _, a0 in ipairs(group) do
                        if neutral[a0.Parent] then
                            for _, a1 in ipairs(group) do
                                if a0.Parent ~= a1.Parent and not neutral[a1.Parent] then
                                    local motor = Instance.new("Motor6D")
                                    motor.Name = name:gsub("RigAttachment$", "")
                                    motor.Part0, motor.Part1, motor.C0, motor.C1 = a0.Parent, a1.Parent, a0.CFrame, a1.CFrame
                                    motor.Parent = a1.Parent
                                    addJoint(motor.Part0, motor.Part1, motor.C0, motor.C1, motor)
                                    repaired = true
                                    neutral = solve(CFrame.identity, false)
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                if not repaired then break end
            end
        end
        for _, part in ipairs(bodyParts) do assert(neutral[part], "Missing rig connection: " .. part.Name) end
        for _, accessory in ipairs(model:GetChildren()) do
            if accessory:IsA("Accessory") then
                local handle = accessory:FindFirstChild("Handle")
                local targetPart, offset
                if handle and handle:IsA("BasePart") then
                    for _, attachment in ipairs(handle:GetChildren()) do
                        if attachment:IsA("Attachment") then
                            for _, body in ipairs(bodyParts) do
                                local match = body:FindFirstChild(attachment.Name)
                                if match and match:IsA("Attachment") then
                                    targetPart, offset = body, match.CFrame * attachment.CFrame:Inverse()
                                    break
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        if targetPart then break end
                    end
                    if not targetPart then
                        local weld = handle:FindFirstChild("AccessoryWeld")
                        if weld and weld:IsA("Weld") then
                            if weld.Part0 == handle and graph[weld.Part1] then targetPart, offset = weld.Part1, weld.C1 * weld.C0:Inverse()
                            elseif weld.Part1 == handle and graph[weld.Part0] then targetPart, offset = weld.Part0, weld.C0 * weld.C1:Inverse() end
                        end
                    end
                    for _, part in ipairs(accessory:GetDescendants()) do
                        if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                            if targetPart then
                                table.insert(accessories, {part = part, target = targetPart,
                                    offset = offset * handle.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(part.CFrame)})
                                if targetPart.Name == "Head" then headParts[part] = true end
                            else part.Transparency = 1 end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        local lowest = math.huge
        for _, foot in ipairs(feet) do lowest = math.min(lowest, bottomY(neutral[foot], foot.Size)) end
        local visualHeight = lowest < math.huge and -lowest or visualHumanoid.HipHeight + visualRoot.Size.Y / 2
        local originalHeight = humanoid.HipHeight + root.Size.Y / 2
        if humanoid.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6 then
            local leg = character:FindFirstChild("Left Leg")
            originalHeight = originalHeight + (leg and leg.Size.Y or 2)
        end
        local baseOffset = visualHeight - originalHeight
        local rayParams = RaycastParams.new()
        rayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {character, model}
        rayParams.IgnoreWater, rayParams.RespectCanCollide = true, true
        local function draw(grounded)
            local look = root.CFrame.LookVector
            local direction = Vector3.new(look.X, 0, look.Z)
            if direction.Magnitude < 0.001 then direction = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1) end
            local position = root.Position + Vector3.new(0, baseOffset, 0)
            local poses = solve(CFrame.lookAt(position, position + direction.Unit), true)
            local correction = 0
            if grounded then
                local hit = workspace:Raycast(root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0),
                    Vector3.new(0, -(originalHeight + 5), 0), rayParams)
                if hit then
                    local bottom = math.huge
                    for _, foot in ipairs(feet) do bottom = math.min(bottom, bottomY(poses[foot], foot.Size)) end
                    if bottom < math.huge then correction = hit.Position.Y + 0.025 - bottom end
                end
            end
            local shift = Vector3.new(0, correction, 0)
            for _, part in ipairs(bodyParts) do part.CFrame = poses[part] + shift end
            for _, binding in ipairs(accessories) do binding.part.CFrame = poses[binding.target] * binding.offset + shift end
        end
        draw(false)
        model.Parent = workspace
        state.model = model
        local animator = visualHumanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
        if not animator then animator = Instance.new("Animator") animator.Parent = visualHumanoid end
        for name, id in pairs(animationIds) do
            local animation = Instance.new("Animation")
            animation.Name, animation.AnimationId, animation.Parent = name, id, model
            local trackOk, track = pcall(function() return animator:LoadAnimation(animation) end)
            if trackOk then
                track.Looped = name ~= "jump"
                track.Priority = name == "idle" and Enum.AnimationPriority.Idle or Enum.AnimationPriority.Movement
                state.tracks[name] = track
            else warn("Unable to load animation " .. name .. ": " .. tostring(track)) end
        end
        local sharedStatus = "Shared idle unavailable"
        local originalAnimator = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
        if humanoid.RigType ~= visualHumanoid.RigType then sharedStatus = "Shared idle: R6/R15 mismatch"
        elseif originalAnimator and state.tracks.idle then
            local animation = Instance.new("Animation")
            animation.Name, animation.AnimationId, animation.Parent = "AvatarSharedIdle", animationIds.idle, character
            state.sharedAnimation = animation
            local sharedOk, track = pcall(function() return originalAnimator:LoadAnimation(animation) end)
            if sharedOk then
                track.Looped, track.Priority = true, Enum.AnimationPriority.Action
                state.sharedTrack, sharedStatus = track, "Shared idle enabled"
            else animation:Destroy() state.sharedAnimation = nil warn(tostring(track)) end
        end
        local currentAnimation
        local function pauseShared()
            if state.sharedTrack and state.sharedTrack.IsPlaying then state.sharedTrack:Stop(0.15) end
        end
        local function play(name, speed)
            if not state.tracks[name] then name = "idle" end
            local track = state.tracks[name]
            if not track then return end
            if currentAnimation ~= name then
                local previous = currentAnimation and state.tracks[currentAnimation]
                if previous then previous:Stop(0.15) end
                currentAnimation = name
                track:Play(0.15)
            elseif track.Looped and not track.IsPlaying then track:Play(0.15) end
            track:AdjustSpeed(speed or 1)
        end
        local function hide(object)
            if object:IsA("BasePart") or object:IsA("Decal") then
                if state.hidden[object] == nil then state.hidden[object] = object.LocalTransparencyModifier end
                object.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
            end
        end
        for _, object in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do hide(object) end
        connect(character.DescendantAdded, hide, true)
        connect(RunService.PreSimulation, function()
            for _, part in ipairs(parts) do
                if part.Parent then part.Anchored, part.CanCollide, part.CanTouch, part.CanQuery = true, false, false, false end
            end
        end, true)
        play("idle")
        connect(RunService.PreRender, function()
            if not root.Parent or not model.Parent or player.Character ~= character then pauseShared() return end
            local movementState = humanoid:GetState()
            local grounded = humanoid.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air and not humanoid.Sit
                and movementState ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping and movementState ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall
                and movementState ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing and movementState ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Swimming
            draw(grounded)
            for object in pairs(state.hidden) do if object.Parent then object.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1 end end
            local camera, head = workspace.CurrentCamera, character:FindFirstChild("Head")
            local firstPerson = camera and head and (camera.CFrame.Position - head.Position).Magnitude < 1
            for part in pairs(headParts) do part.LocalTransparencyModifier = firstPerson and 1 or 0 end
            if humanoid.Health <= 0 then
                pauseShared()
                for _, track in pairs(state.tracks) do if track.IsPlaying then track:Stop(0.15) end end
                return
            end
            local velocity = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
            local speed = Vector3.new(velocity.X, 0, velocity.Z).Magnitude
            local moving = humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.05
            if humanoid.Sit then play("sit")
            elseif movementState == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping then play("jump")
            elseif movementState == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall then play("fall")
            elseif movementState == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing then play("climb", math.clamp(math.abs(velocity.Y) / 5, 0, 3))
            elseif movementState == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Swimming then
                if velocity.Magnitude > 1 then play("swim", math.clamp(velocity.Magnitude / 10, 0.2, 3)) else play("swimidle") end
            elseif moving and speed > 0.5 then
                if speed > 10 then play("run", math.clamp(speed / 16, 0.2, 3)) else play("walk", math.clamp(speed / 8, 0.2, 3)) end
            else play("idle") end
            local standing = movementState == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running
                or movementState == Enum.HumanoidStateType.RunningNoPhysics or movementState == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed
            local localIdle = state.tracks.idle
            if state.sharedTrack and localIdle and localIdle.IsPlaying and grounded and standing
                and not humanoid.PlatformStand and not moving and speed < 0.75 and currentAnimation == "idle" then
                local shared = state.sharedTrack
                if not shared.IsPlaying then
                    shared:Play(0.2, 1, 1)
                    if shared.Length > 0 then shared.TimePosition = localIdle.TimePosition % shared.Length end
                end
                shared:AdjustSpeed(localIdle.Speed)
            else pauseShared() end
        end, true)
        snapshot.AnimationIds = animationIds
        state.selectedSnapshot = snapshot
        input.Text = snapshot.Username
        setStatus("Applied @" .. snapshot.Username .. " • " .. tostring(#snapshot.Accessories)
            .. " accessories captured\n" .. sharedStatus)
    end)
    if description then description:Destroy() end
    if not ok then
        if model then model:Destroy() end
        if not cancelled() then
            state:ClearAvatar()
            state.selectedSnapshot = nil
            setStatus(tostring(err):match("[^\n]+$") or "Loading failed.", true)
        end
        warn("Avatar changer: " .. tostring(err))
    end
end

local function longQuote(text)
    local equals = ""
    while (text .. "]" .. equals .. "]"):find("]" .. equals .. "]", 1, true) ~= #text + 1 do
        equals = equals .. "="
    end
    return "[" .. equals .. "[\n" .. text .. "]" .. equals .. "]"
end

local function isRemote(d)
    return d:IsA("RemoteEvent") or d:IsA("RemoteFunction") or d:IsA("BindableEvent")
end

local function findRemote(names)
    local pool = {}
    for _, n in ipairs(names) do
        local hit = RS:FindFirstChild(n, true) or WS:FindFirstChild(n, true)
        if hit then table.insert(pool, hit) end
    end
    local rake = WS:FindFirstChild("the_rake", true)
    if rake then
        for _, d in ipairs(rake:GetDescendants()) do
            if isRemote(d) then table.insert(pool, d) end
        end
    end
    for _, d in ipairs(RS:GetDescendants()) do
        if isRemote(d) and d.Name:lower():find("startmode") then
            table.insert(pool, d)
        end
    end
    return pool
end

section("combat", function()
    -- ---- DROPS DATA ----
    -- add more drops here. "id" is the debug id from your snippet; debug ids
    -- change between sessions, so if the exact id isn't found it falls back
    -- to the first nil instance with that name.
    local DROPS = {
        {name = "Coin",       id = "1_200886"},
        {name = "TrainerCap", id = "1_239393"},
    }
    local dropChance = 25

    local function getNil(name, debugId)
        if not getnilinstances then return nil end
        for _, o in ipairs(getnilinstances()) do
            if o.Name == name then
                if not debugId or o:GetDebugId() == debugId then
                    return o
                end
            end
        end
    end

    local nilCache = {}
    local function resolveDrop(d)
        if nilCache[d.name] then return nilCache[d.name] end
        local inst = getNil(d.name, d.id) or getNil(d.name)
        nilCache[d.name] = inst
        return inst
    end

    local function posOf(o)
        if typeof(o) ~= "Instance" then return nil end
        local ok, p = pcall(function()
            if o:IsA("BasePart") then return o.Position end
            if o:IsA("Model") then return o:GetPivot().Position end
            if o:IsA("Tool") then
                local h = o:FindFirstChild("Handle")
                return h and h.Position
            end
        end)
        return ok and p or nil
    end

    local function tpTo(p, fromDrop)
        local root = getRoot()
        if root and p then
            root.CFrame = CFrame.new(p + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
            if fromDrop then aiPauseUntil = tick() + 1.5 end
        end
    end

    -- fires the SpawnDrop signal with the nil instance, like your snippets
    local function spawnDrop(d)
        local ev = RS:FindFirstChild("SpawnDrop")
        if not ev then notify("SpawnDrop remote not found") return false end
        if not firesignal then notify("Your executor has no firesignal") return false end
        local inst = resolveDrop(d)
        if not inst then
            notify("Couldn't find '" .. d.name .. "' (needs getnilinstances)")
            return false
        end
        firesignal(ev.OnClientEvent, inst)
        return true
    end

    -- picks a random drop, fires it, then teleports to where it appeared
    local function rollDrop(fallbackPos)
        local d = DROPS[math.random(#DROPS)]
        local found
        local c = WS.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(o)
            if o.Name == d.name then found = o end
        end)
        local ok = spawnDrop(d)
        task.wait(0.3)
        c:Disconnect()
        if ok and tpDrop then
            tpTo(posOf(found) or fallbackPos, true)
        end
    end

    -- teleport to drops the game spawns by itself
    local dropConn = nil
    local function bindDropListener()
        if dropConn then return true end
        local ev = RS:FindFirstChild("SpawnDrop")
        if not ev then return false end
        dropConn = ev.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(obj)
            if not tpDrop then return end
            if typeof(obj) ~= "Instance" or not obj:IsDescendantOf(WS) then return end
            task.wait(0.1)
            tpTo(posOf(obj), true)
        end)
        track(dropConn)
        return true
    end

    -- watches enemies and rolls a drop when one dies
    local hooked = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
    local function hookEnemy(m, hum)
        if hooked[m] then return end
        hooked[m] = true
        if hum.Health <= 0 then return end
        track(hum.Died:Connect(function()
            if not dropsOn then return end
            if math.random() * 100 > dropChance then return end
            local ok, pos = pcall(function() return m:GetPivot().Position end)
            task.spawn(rollDrop, ok and pos or nil)
        end))
    end

    task.spawn(function()
        while alive do
            task.wait(1)
            if dropsOn then
                for _, m in ipairs(WS:GetChildren()) do
                    if m:IsA("Model") and m ~= LP.Character
                    and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(m) == nil then
                        local mh = m:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                        if mh then hookEnemy(m, mh) end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end)

    -- ---- TARGETING (shared by Auto Rakoof, Aim Lock, Hitbox, Teleport to Rakoof) ----
    local aiTeleport, limitRange, hitRange, preferRakoof = true, false, 60, true

    local function validTarget(m)
        if not m or not m.Parent then return false end
        local h = m:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if h and h.Health <= 0 then return false end
        return true
    end

    local function partOf(m)
        return m:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            or m.PrimaryPart
            or m:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
    end

    -- looks through a list for a model named like "rakoof"
    -- (falls back to a living "rake" model with a Humanoid, e.g. the_rake)
    local function scan(list)
        local fallback
        for _, d in ipairs(list) do
            if d:IsA("Model") and not Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(d) then
                local h = d:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if not h or h.Health > 0 then
                    local n = d.Name:lower()
                    if n:find("rakoof") then
                        return d
                    elseif not fallback and h and n:find("rake") then
                        fallback = d
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return fallback
    end

    local rakoofCache, lastDeep = nil, 0
    local function getRakoof()
        if validTarget(rakoofCache) then return rakoofCache end
        rakoofCache = scan(WS:GetChildren())
        if not rakoofCache and tick() - lastDeep > 2 then
            lastDeep = tick()
            rakoofCache = scan(WS:GetDescendants())
        end
        return rakoofCache
    end

    local function nearestEnemy(root, useLimit)
        local best, bestPart, bestD = nil, nil, math.huge
        for _, m in ipairs(WS:GetChildren()) do
            if m:IsA("Model") and m ~= LP.Character then
                local mh = m:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                local mr = m:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if mh and mr and mh.Health > 0 and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(m) == nil then
                    local d = (mr.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
                    if (not useLimit or d <= hitRange) and d < bestD then
                        bestD, best, bestPart = d, m, mr
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return best, bestPart
    end

    local function pickTarget(root, useLimit)
        if preferRakoof then
            local rk = getRakoof()
            local rp = rk and partOf(rk)
            if rp and (not useLimit or (rp.Position - root.Position).Magnitude <= hitRange) then
                return rk, rp
            end
        end
        return nearestEnemy(root, useLimit)
    end

    -- ---- AUTO RAKOOF ----
    label(pCombat, "Auto Rakoof")
    local aiCon = nil

    toggle(pCombat, "Auto Rakoof", function(v)
        aiOn = v
        if aiCon then aiCon:Disconnect(); aiCon = nil end
        if not v then return end
        aiCon = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
            if tick() < aiPauseUntil then return end
            local char = LP.Character
            local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not root then return end

            local m, mr = pickTarget(root, limitRange)
            if not m or not mr then return end

            if aiTeleport then
                local target = mr.Position + (mr.CFrame.LookVector * -1) * standDist + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)
                root.CFrame = CFrame.new(target, mr.Position)
            end
            local tool = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
            if tool then pcall(function() tool:Activate() end) end
        end)
        track(aiCon)
    end)

    local setRF = toggle(pCombat, "Rakoof First", function(v) preferRakoof = v end)
    setRF(true)
    local setTPEnemy = toggle(pCombat, "Teleport to Enemy", function(v) aiTeleport = v end)
    setTPEnemy(true)
    toggle(pCombat, "Limit Hit Range", function(v) limitRange = v end)
    slider(pCombat, "Hit Range (studs)", 5, 500, hitRange, function(v) hitRange = v end)
    slider(pCombat, "Stand Distance", 3, 20, standDist, function(v) standDist = v end)

    -- ---- RAKOOF HITBOX ----
    label(pCombat, "Rakoof Hitbox")
    local hbOn, hbAll, hbShow, hbSize = false, false, true, 25
    local hbOriginal = {}   -- [part] = original properties
    local hbModel = nil

    local function hbRestore()
        for part, o in pairs(hbOriginal) do
            if part and part.Parent then
                pcall(function()
                    part.Size = o.Size
                    part.Transparency = o.Transparency
                    part.CanCollide = o.CanCollide
                    part.Massless = o.Massless
                end)
            end
        end
        hbOriginal = {}
        hbModel = nil
    end
    restoreHitbox = hbRestore

    local function hbApply(part)
        if not hbOriginal[part] then
            hbOriginal[part] = {
                Size = part.Size,
                Transparency = part.Transparency,
                CanCollide = part.CanCollide,
                Massless = part.Massless,
            }
        end
        local o = hbOriginal[part]
        local want = o.Size + Vector3.new(hbSize, hbSize, hbSize)
        if part.Size ~= want then part.Size = want end
        part.CanCollide = false
        part.Massless = true
        part.Transparency = hbShow and math.max(0.55, o.Transparency) or o.Transparency
    end

    task.spawn(function()
        while alive do
            task.wait(0.25)
            if hbOn then
                local m = getRakoof()
                if m then
                    if hbModel ~= m then
                        hbRestore()
                        hbModel = m
                    end
                    if hbAll then
                        for _, p in ipairs(m:GetDescendants()) do
                            if p:IsA("BasePart") then pcall(hbApply, p) end
                        end
                    else
                        local rp = partOf(m)
                        if rp then pcall(hbApply, rp) end
                    end
                elseif hbModel then
                    hbRestore() -- Rakoof is gone
                end
            end
        end
    end)

    toggle(pCombat, "Expand Rakoof Hitbox", function(v)
        hbOn = v
        if not v then
            hbRestore()
            return
        end
        if not getRakoof() then
            notify("Rakoof not found yet - will apply when he spawns")
        end
    end)
    slider(pCombat, "Hitbox Size", 1, 100, hbSize, function(v) hbSize = v end)
    local setHbShow = toggle(pCombat, "Show Hitbox", function(v)
        hbShow = v
        if hbOn then hbRestore() end -- reapplies with the new look next tick
    end)
    setHbShow(true)
    toggle(pCombat, "All Parts", function(v)
        hbAll = v
        if hbOn then hbRestore() end -- reapplies for the new mode next tick
    end)

    -- ---- AIM LOCK ----
    label(pCombat, "Aim Lock")
    local aimStrength, aimHead = 100, false
    local aimTarget, aimPart, aimAt = nil, nil, 0
    local AIM_BIND = "eva_aim_" .. tostring(math.random(1000, 9999))

    local function aimStep()
        local cm = WS.CurrentCamera
        local root = getRoot()
        if not cm or not root then return end
        -- re-pick the target a few times a second instead of every frame
        if tick() - aimAt > 0.25 or not (aimPart and aimPart.Parent) then
            aimAt = tick()
            aimTarget, aimPart = pickTarget(root, false)
        end
        if not aimPart then return end
        local pos = aimPart.Position
        if aimHead and aimTarget then
            local h = aimTarget:FindFirstChild("Head")
            if h and h:IsA("BasePart") then pos = h.Position end
        end
        local goal = CFrame.new(cm.CFrame.Position, pos)
        local a = aimStrength / 100
        cm.CFrame = (a >= 1) and goal or cm.CFrame:Lerp(goal, a)
    end

    stopAim = function()
        aimOn = false
        pcall(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(AIM_BIND) end)
    end

    toggle(pCombat, "Aim Lock (Rakoof)", function(v)
        stopAim()
        if not v then return end
        aimOn = true
        aimAt = 0
        local ok = pcall(function()
            RunService:BindToRenderStep(AIM_BIND, Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, aimStep)
        end)
        if ok then
            notify("Aim lock on")
        else
            aimOn = false
            notify("Aim lock failed to start")
        end
    end)
    slider(pCombat, "Lock Strength", 5, 100, aimStrength, function(v) aimStrength = v end)
    toggle(pCombat, "Aim at Head", function(v) aimHead = v end)

    -- ---- TELEPORT ----
    label(pCombat, "Teleport")
    button(pCombat, "Teleport to Rakoof", function()
        local m = getRakoof()
        if not m then notify("Rakoof not found") return end
        local root = getRoot()
        if not root then return end
        local ok, cf = pcall(function() return m:GetPivot() end)
        if not ok then notify("Couldn't read Rakoof's position") return end
        local target = cf.Position + (cf.LookVector * -1) * standDist + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)
        root.CFrame = CFrame.new(target, cf.Position)
        root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
        aiPauseUntil = tick() + 1.5
    end)

    -- ---- DROPS UI ----
    label(pCombat, "Drops")
    toggle(pCombat, "Enemy Drops", function(v) dropsOn = v end)
    slider(pCombat, "Drop Chance %", 0, 100, dropChance, function(v) dropChance = v end)

    toggle(pCombat, "Teleport to Drops", function(v)
        tpDrop = v
        if v and not bindDropListener() then
            notify("SpawnDrop not found - only enemy drops teleport")
        end
    end)

    button(pCombat, "Spawn Random Drop Now", function()
        local root = getRoot()
        task.spawn(rollDrop, root and root.Position or nil)
    end)

    -- ---- AUTO PICKUP + AUTO CANDY ----
    label(pCombat, "Automation")

    local function touch(root, part)
        if firetouchinterest then
            pcall(firetouchinterest, root, part, 0)
            pcall(firetouchinterest, root, part, 1)
        elseif not part.Anchored then
            pcall(function() part.CFrame = root.CFrame end)
        end
    end

    -- picks up tools plus parts named drop / coin / item
    toggle(pCombat, "Auto Pickup", function(v)
        pickupOn = v
        if not v then return end
        task.spawn(function()
            while pickupOn and alive do
                local root = getRoot()
                if root then
                    for _, o in ipairs(WS:GetDescendants()) do
                        if not pickupOn then break end
                        local part
                        if o:IsA("Tool") then
                            part = o:FindFirstChild("Handle")
                        elseif o:IsA("BasePart") then
                            local n = o.Name:lower()
                            if n:find("drop") or n:find("coin") or n:find("item") then
                                part = o
                            end
                        end
                        if part and part:IsA("BasePart")
                        and (part.Position - root.Position).Magnitude < 60 then
                            touch(root, part)
                        end
                    end
                end
                task.wait(0.4)
            end
        end)
    end)

    -- teleports to candy corn / buckets / packs and touches them
    toggle(pCombat, "Auto Candy", function(v)
        candyOn = v
        if not v then return end
        task.spawn(function()
            while candyOn and alive do
                local root = getRoot()
                if root then
                    for _, o in ipairs(WS:GetDescendants()) do
                        if not candyOn then break end
                        local n = o.Name:lower()
                        if n:find("candycorn") or n:find("candybucket") or n:find("candypack") then
                            local part = o:IsA("BasePart") and o
                                or o:FindFirstChild("Handle")
                                or o:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
                            if part then
                                aiPauseUntil = tick() + 0.6 -- keep Auto Rakoof from pulling you away
                                root.CFrame = part.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)
                                touch(root, part)
                                task.wait(0.3)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                task.wait(0.5)
            end
        end)
    end)

    -- ---- ACTIONS ----
    label(pCombat, "Actions")
    button(pCombat, "Trigger StartMode", function()
        local hits = findRemote({"StartMode", "startmode", "StartModeRemote"})
        if #hits == 0 then notify("No StartMode remote found") return end
        for _, r in ipairs(hits) do
            pcall(function()
                if r:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
                    r:FireServer("HellsAwakening")
                    r:FireServer("HellsAwakeningMain")
                elseif r:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
                    r:InvokeServer("HellsAwakening")
                elseif r:IsA("BindableEvent") then
                    r:Fire("HellsAwakening")
                end
            end)
        end
    end)

    button(pCombat, "Force Drop Item", function()
        local hits = findRemote({"SpawnItem", "spawnitem", "SpawnItemRemote"})
        if #hits == 0 then notify("No SpawnItem remote found") return end
        local char = LP.Character
        local tool = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
        local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not tool or not root then notify("Equip a tool first") return end
        for _, r in ipairs(hits) do
            pcall(function()
                if r:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
                    r:FireServer(tool.Name, root.Position)
                elseif r:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
                    r:InvokeServer(tool.Name, root.Position)
                end
            end)
        end
    end)
end)
